policy: Approval requires an independently reviewed X status with explicit creator authorization, a consent record and actual sanitized WebP file committed by the maintainer. No automatic social-media scraping, downloads or publishing of community photos. An empty registry means no new approved photo exists. Each approved photo must include an independently human-verified step_number mapping to a real numbered instruction; photo-request role 1-5 must never be automatically treated as a tutorial step. The photo is rendered immediately beneath that instruction with a small original-post attribution, not in a second gallery.
